decisions.statement: The substrate changes the authority answer, never the vocabulary: one seven-verb set spans owned UI, embedded modules and intact services
decisions.support: Three worked traces run the same vocabulary across three substrates; only the authority cell differs
decisions.falsifier: A real client request expressible on owned UI whose donor equivalent needs an eighth verb and is not an escalation

decisions.statement: The mechanical axis that decides the P08 mount profile also decides which edits are possible on it
decisions.support: theme on intact_service is denied by cross-origin custom-property inheritance — the same fact that moves a donor from preserved_framed to absorbed_native (THEMING-CONTRACT.md:94-102)
decisions.falsifier: An edit authority answer that contradicts the mount profile derived from the same coupling gates
decisions.note: The coherence claim of this lane: one mechanical fact read twice

decisions.statement: Upgrade survival is decided by anchor class, not by verb or authority level
decisions.support: Trace T3: two allowed low/medium-authority edits, one RESOLVED (contract_slot) and one DEGRADED (donor_export), differing only in anchor class
decisions.falsifier: A contract_slot edit that orphans, or a donor_export edit that reliably survives several real bumps

decisions.statement: `coordinate` is absent from the anchor enum by construction; coordinate-bound edits are unrepresentable
decisions.support: I-P13-2 — a mutation bound to a node index cannot survive an upgrade that moves the node. Enforcement is the schema's shape, not a runtime check.
decisions.falsifier: A legitimate client edit expressible only as a coordinate and not as any semantic anchor

decisions.statement: Permission lives in the persisted composition record, never in editor configuration
decisions.support: Puck encodes per-field readOnly inside BaseData so the prohibition travels with the content. Editor-only permission is bypassed by upgrades, migrations, agents and direct API writes — and I-P13-1 guarantees multiple channels exist.
decisions.falsifier: An editor-only permission model surviving an upgrade, a migration and an agent write unmodified

decisions.statement: There is deliberately no state for a silently discarded edit; DEGRADED and ORPHANED are kept, named, and block auto-publish
decisions.support: The Shopify failure mode is a silent drop discovered after publish. A model able to express a silent drop reproduces the bug it exists to prevent.
decisions.falsifier: An upgrade passing the post-diff gate that still loses client-visible edits
decisions.evidence_scope: Two merchant reports plus a staff acknowledgement of receipt, 2026-03-24. Not a measured failure rate, not a root cause, not an on-record bug acknowledgement.

decisions.statement: `replace` escalates on donors but not on owned UI
decisions.support: Replacing a donor changes the composition member set and therefore its scope intersection, rights state, runtime profile and rollback surface. Calling it an edit would let a client re-plan the product through the editor.
decisions.falsifier: A donor replacement with no scope, rights, runtime or rollback consequence
decisions.cross_lane_edge: S2-L1 module contracts and S2-L4 composition inputs

decisions.statement: Refusal quality is a product surface, not an error branch
decisions.support: Every AI builder in the 30-surface census chose unbounded fallthrough. Actionist is deliberately taking the posture the market declined, so `denied` must carry a named constraint, a priced alternative and a free fallback.
decisions.falsifier: Pilot clients treat refusals as product failure regardless of alternative quality
decisions.note: The largest commercial risk in P13; E-P13-4 unrun

decisions.statement: Every donor_export anchor is a permanent merge obligation and must be a priced decision with an owner
decisions.support: Built estate guards every patch hunk with if (process.env.SISO_*) so upstream behaviour is the default; one absorption widened a donor's public API validation regex to permit schema-qualified names
decisions.falsifier: A donor whose exported anchors survive several minor bumps with no patch maintenance
